title: Trastuzumab Deruxtecan (DS-8201a) Versus Investigator's Choice for HER2-low Breast Cancer That Has Spread or Cannot be Surgically Removed [DESTINY-Breast04]

criteria.label: Is the age of majority in their country
Pathologically documented unresectable or metastatic breast cancer
HER2-low expression: IHC 2+/ISH- or IHC 1+ (ISH- or untested)
Treated with 1 to 2 prior lines of chemotherapy in the recurrent or metastatic setting
No spinal cord compression or clinically active CNS metastases
Protocol-defined adequate cardiac, bone marrow, renal, hepatic, and blood clotting function
At least 1 measurable lesion per RECIST 1.1
No prior anti-HER2 therapy, including antibody-drug conjugates
Washout period of at least 21 days since last therapy
